segments.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל: מִין בְּמִינוֹ — בְּמַשֶּׁהוּ, שֶׁלֹּא בְּמִינוֹ — בְּנוֹתֵן טַעַם.
segments.en: § The mishna states that «this is the principle: A substance» in contact «with» the «same» type of «substance» renders the mixture forbidden «with any amount» of the forbidden substance, «but» a substance in contact «with a different» type of «substance» renders the mixture forbidden only «in» a case where it «imparts flavor» to it.

moves.summary: Quotes the mishna's general principle as the lemma for the next discussion
moves.about: the mishna's principle: same kind forbids in any amount, other kind by imparting flavor

edges.about: the mishna's principle: same kind forbids in any amount, other kind by imparting flavor

positions.claim: same kind forbids in any amount; different kind only when imparting flavor
